newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN POLICE PROBE 3.0 MILLION RAND FRAUD.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN POLICE PROBE 3.0 MILLION RAND FRAUD.

text.p: South African police said on Wednesday they had arrested the head of a fraud syndicate that had cheated the government out of about 3.0 million rand in unemployment benefits.
A statement said a total of 17 people had been arrested in the two-month-old investigation and another 55 would probably be brought in.
"The department of labour has indicated that a minimum amount of 3.0 million rand is involved," the statement said.
It said syndicate leaders had obtained money from the labour department by fraudulently filling in claims for unemployment benefits. They would appear in court next month, the statement said.
